urls.description: This dataset provides global Groundwater Storage Change (GWSC) expressed as storage anomalies on a 0.5° regular grid. The dataset provides a value of groundwater storage change in mm equivalent water height and its uncertainty for each grid cell. The dataset is part of the Essential Climate Variable (ECV) Service called Terrestrial Water Storage and Groundwater, comprising of ECV Products for Terrestrial Water Storage Anomalies (TWSA) and GWSC. The data represents the currently only available technology to measure changes in groundwater storage on a global scale. The dataset is a Level-4 product (compare section 1.1.2.1. in the Product User Guide and Specification (PUGS)) that provides groundwater storage change as mm equivalent water height on a regular grid. Input datasets are (Level-3) terrestrial water storage and global datasets on water storage change derived from glacier mass, snow cover, root zone soil moisture and surface water.
